title: contentTracing.stopRecording writes an empty trace after a successful capture
body:
### Electron Version

42.2.0

### What operating system(s) are you using?

macOS

### Operating System Version

macOS 14.7

### Expected Behavior

The trace contains recorded events.

### Actual Behavior

startRecording resolves, the sample generates activity for one second, and stopRecording resolves to a trace file that is zero bytes.

### Testcase Gist URL

_No response_

### Additional Information

Minimal runnable repository: https://github.com/reproduction-fixtures/empty-trace-minimal
Clone the repository, run npm install and npm start. It contains package.json, main.cjs and the local activity page. main.cjs starts tracing, runs the activity, stops tracing and prints the trace file size. No private assets or external services are required.
